tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List current StaffBots plans and add-ons with prices and highlights. Buyers start a 14-day free trial at staffbots.ai/signup?plan=<id>. No card is required. Then they add a card in Billing. Use this before recommending a plan or quoting a price.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Alias of list_plans. Same catalog, same prices, no extra claims.

tools.name: get_product_overview
tools.description: What StaffBots is, who it is for, and how the 14-day trial works. Copy comes from the published site facts. No tenant data.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: Industry pages published on staffbots.ai, with titles and URLs. No extra claims.

tools.name: compare_to
tools.description: Return the published comparison page for a competitor already on staffbots.ai (Onfleet, DailyDSP, DSP Workplace, Virtual Dispatcher, offshore VA agencies, AI receptionist tools, or an in-house dispatcher). The excerpt is the page text. Do not add claims.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search llms-full.txt and the public markdown mirrors. Returns titles, URLs, and short snippets.

tools.name: book_demo_link
tools.description: Return the public demo and signup URLs. Does not submit a request and does not write anything.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Get details for one StaffBots plan or add-on. Accepted values: starter, dispatch, biab (or 'business in a box'), reseller, supervisor (Human Supervisor add-on).

tools.name: recommend_plan
tools.description: Recommend a StaffBots plan from business type, optional team size, and needs (dispatch, support, scheduling, lead follow-up, admin, reseller). Returns a rationale and the signup URL. Starter, Dispatch VA, and Business in a Box are a 14-day free trial with no card. Then add a card in Billing. Does no

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Return the signup URL for starter, dispatch, biab, or reseller. Starter, Dispatch VA, and Business in a Box start a 14-day free trial with no card. Then add a card in Billing. Reseller is billed from day one. Human Supervisor has no public signup link.

tools.name: compare_vs_offshore_va
tools.description: Compare StaffBots AI virtual assistants with hiring a typical offshore VA or dispatcher. Uses official StaffBots prices and typical 2026 third-party market ranges — not StaffBots-verified savings or testimonials.

tools.name: faq_search
tools.description: Search official StaffBots FAQ answers about plans, pricing, resellers, StaffBots OS, contact, and brand disambiguation versus StaffBot at staffbot.ai.

tools.name: book_demo_request
tools.description: Collect a demo or walkthrough request (name, email, company, message, plan interest) and email it to hello@staffbots.ai. When email is not configured, the request is stored for the team instead.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_industries, search_docs, get_checkout_link · Private data: faq_search · Public sink: book_demo_link, book_demo_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_industries, search_docs, get_checkout_link · Private data: faq_search · Public sink: book_demo_link, book_demo_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_plans" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List current StaffBots plans and add-ons with prices, highlights, and checkout URLs. Buyers start a 14-day free trial at staffbots.ai/signup?plan=<id>. No card is required. Then they add a card in Billing. Use this before recommending a plan or quoting a price."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
